metadata.scenario: A customer demands a review of the incorrect charges applied to their account for housekeeping. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I’m calling about some incorrect charges I noticed on my account. I’m sorry to hear that, Betty. Could you please provide me with more details about those charges? Yes, there are charges for housekeeping services that I never requested. I understand. Let me look into your account and see what I can find regarding those charges. Thank you. I’ve been a client for ten months now for fall prevention and mobility assistance, so I’m surprised to see these extra fees. I appreciate your patience, Betty. I’m pulling up your account right now. Just one moment, please. It appears there was a billing error that applied housekeeping charges to your account for this month. I apologize for the mistake. I really need those charges removed. I didn’t receive any housekeeping services. Absolutely, we’ll correct that. I’ll ensure that those charges are reversed. Thank you. How long will that take to process? It usually takes 3 to 5 business days for billing adjustments to reflect in your account. That sounds reasonable. I appreciate you handling it. Of course! Is there anything else on your mind today? Well, since I have you, I’ve been considering increasing my personal care assistance hours. That’s a great idea, Betty! We offer personal care assistance at $28 to $35 per hour. I’d like to increase my hours from 10 to 20 per week. What would that look like? Let me calculate that for you. At an average of $32 per hour, that would be around $640 a month. That sounds manageable. Can we arrange that? Yes, I can have Lisa, our Care Coordinator, reach out to finalize the schedule with you. Perfect! I’d like to ensure I have consistent caregivers as well. I’ll make a note to discuss that with Lisa as well. Thank you so much, Margaret. I really appreciate your help today. You're welcome, Betty! I’ll ensure everything is taken care of, and Lisa will call you shortly. Thank you, I look forward to hearing from her. Have a great day! You too, Betty! Take care.
